title: Nonparametric Segmentation Methods: Applications of Unsupervised Machine Learning and Revealed Preference
Tribal Water Rights, Community Economies, and Adaptive Water Institutions in the Western United States
venue: Journal of Natural Resources Policy Research
abstract: Adaptive institutional response is evident over the many decades in which Native American tribes in the western United States have sought to overcome persistent socioeconomic challenges to tribal economic development and improved standards of living. Thriving indigenous communities with active regional economic trade characterized much of North American prior to European colonization, but many tribes in the United States today struggle with poverty. In this study, U.S. Census Bureau data are linked with several other data sources to better understand how “tribal presence” and tribal water entitlements are related to economic well-being. This study finds that tribal land and Native American population are related to lower per capita income and higher poverty at western U.S. county spatial scales. Low educational attainment, limited Internet access, urban setting, and climate variability also are linked to lower income and increased household poverty. Counties with tribal presence and quantified tribal water rights tend to be poorer than counties with tribal presence and no quantified tribal water rights, suggesting poverty as a motivation for pursuing water entitlements.
abstract_zh: 美国西部的部落水权、社区经济与适应性水资源制度。数十年来，美国西部的美洲原住民部落为克服持续存在的社会经济挑战、推动部落经济发展并提高生活水平，不断做出适应性的制度回应。在欧洲殖民之前，北美大部分地区曾存在繁荣的原住民社区，并与区域经济保持着活跃的贸易往来，但如今美国的许多部落仍在贫困中挣扎。本研究将美国人口普查局数据与若干其他数据来源相链接，以更好地理解“部落存在”与部落水权如何与经济福祉相关联。研究发现，在美国西部县级空间尺度上，部落土地和美洲原住民人口与较低的人均收入和较高的贫困率相关。低教育水平、有限的互联网接入、城市化环境以及气候变率也与较低的收入和更高的家庭贫困率相关。与有部落存在但未量化部落水权的县相比，既有部落存在又拥有量化部落水权的县往往更为贫困，这表明贫困是部落追求水权的一个动因。

title: Household Water Demand Seasonal Elasticities: A Stone-Geary Model under an Increasing Block Rate Structure
abstract: Using household-level panel data from Tucson, Arizona, and a unique set of highly disaggregated control variables, we estimate residential demand for water via a Stone-Geary specification. The Stone-Geary functional form allows price elasticity of demand to vary with quantity consumed, price, and income and enables estimation of a threshold level of consumption below which demand is considered perfectly price inelastic. An encompassing test of consumer price response reveals evidence favoring a lagged average price specification rather than one using lagged marginal price. The estimated model also finds substantial seasonal variation in price elasticity and declining consumer price responsiveness.
abstract_zh: 递增阶梯水价下家庭用水需求的季节性弹性：Stone-Geary 模型。利用亚利桑那州图森市的家庭层面面板数据，以及一组高度细化的控制变量，我们通过 Stone-Geary 设定估计了居民用水需求。Stone-Geary 函数形式允许需求的价格弹性随消费量、价格和收入而变化，并使我们能够估计一个消费门槛水平，低于该水平的需求被视为完全无价格弹性。对消费者价格响应的包容性检验表明，相比使用滞后边际价格的设定，证据更支持滞后平均价格的设定。估计模型还发现，价格弹性存在显著的季节性变化，且消费者的价格响应性随时间下降。

Can/Should/Will a Niche Become the Norm? Organic Agriculture's Short Past and Long Future
abstract: A theory is proposed that explains the evolution of a market based on a quality variant as it goes from being a niche to the market norm. Organic commodities are described as such a quality variant and used to focus on the economic and policy issues that arise during a market's evolution. It is shown how organic products in general can become the norm in many American commodity markets. However, there is disagreement over whether it should and much uncertainty about whether it will. The current status of two organic markets is discussed to illustrate empirical issues. (JEL Q130, Q110, Q100)
abstract_zh: 利基市场能否、应否以及将会成为主流？有机农业的过去与长远未来。本文提出了一种理论，用以解释以质量差异化为基础的市场，如何从利基市场发展为市场常态的演化过程。有机农产品被描述为这样一种质量变体，并被用来聚焦市场演化过程中出现的经济与政策问题。本文表明，有机产品总体上如何能够在许多美国农产品市场中成为常态。然而，对于它是否应当成为常态存在分歧，而它是否将会成为常态也存在诸多不确定性。本文讨论了两个有机市场的现状，以说明相关的实证问题。（JEL Q130, Q110, Q100）

abstract: Monte Carlo simulations of profit functions indicate that flexible functional forms may be ranked nearly the same with respect to Allen‐Uzawa partial substitution elasticities or price and fixed factor elasticities. Flexible functional form approximations of output price elasticities are generally worse than approximations of input price or fixed factor elasticities. Minflex Laurent functional forms did not appear to approximate underlying elasticities any better than did their translog and generalized Leontief counterparts.
abstract_zh: 利润函数近似与对偶性在农业中的应用。利润函数的蒙特卡洛模拟表明，就 Allen-Uzawa 偏替代弹性，或价格与固定要素弹性而言，各种灵活函数形式的排序几乎相同。对产出价格弹性的灵活函数形式近似，通常比对投入价格弹性或固定要素弹性的近似更差。Minflex 洛朗（Laurent）函数形式在逼近潜在弹性方面，并不比其超越对数（translog）和广义 Leontief 对应形式表现得更好。

title: Tariff and Non-Tariff Barrier Impacts on Illegal Immigration: The U.S. Fresh Winter Tomato Market
Choice of Flexible Functional Forms: Review and Appraisal
Agricultural Development and Emigration: Rhetoric and Reality
abstract: "The untested premise of trade liberalizing U.S. development programs such as the Caribbean Basin Initiative is that commodity trade can substitute for international labor migration. Analysis of U.S. tomato producing regions in Sinaloa, Mexico and Florida suggests that the effect of trade liberalization on international labor migration is uncertain." The emphasis is on how such development projects might affect the flow of illegal migrants to the United States.
abstract_zh: 农业发展与移民：修辞与现实。“加勒比海盆地倡议等旨在推动贸易自由化的美国发展计划，其未经检验的前提是，商品贸易可以替代国际劳动力迁移。对墨西哥锡那罗亚州与佛罗里达州美国番茄产区的分析表明，贸易自由化对国际劳动力迁移的影响是不确定的。”该研究的重点在于，此类发展项目可能如何影响流向美国的非法移民数量。
